Location: The Netherlands | Full-time | Open to candidates currently based in Spain Are you an Electrical Engineer with experience in Protection & Control, secondary systems or substation automation? As a Secondary Design Engineer – Protection & Control, you will design the systems responsible for the protection, control, measurement and monitoring of medium- and high-voltage substations in the Netherlands. You will work on both greenfield projects and extensions or modernisation of existing substations. What will you do? You will translate functional and client requirements into detailed secondary electrical designs. Your responsibilities can include: Designing Protection & Control systems for MV and HV substations; Developing secondary circuits for protection, control, measurement, signalling and interlocking; Preparing electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and connection diagrams; Engineering protection and control panels; Designing AC and DC auxiliary systems; Defining interfaces between primary equipment and secondary systems; Working with CT and VT secondary circuits; Preparing cable schedules, terminal information and technical documentation; Selecting and specifying electrical equipment and components; Developing material specifications; Translating customer requirements into an engineering solution using a Systems Engineering approach; Preparing technical work packages and specifications for subcontracted activities; Reviewing engineering documents and supplier proposals; Coordinating the secondary design with Primary, Civil, BIM and other engineering disciplines; Supporting engineering during construction, testing and commissioning phases. Depending on your experience, you may also take responsibility for technical coordination or act as Design Lead for specific engineering packages. Arbeidsvoorwaarden €4,000 – €5,500 gross per month, depending on knowledge and experience; 22 vacation days + 13 ATV days: 35 days off per year; Hybrid working possibilitie

and a home-working allowance; Commuting allowance or business public-transport card; A strong pension scheme; Technical training and professional development; The opportunity to specialise further in Protection & Control and Secondary Engineering; Career opportunities towards Senior Engineer, Lead Engineer or Technical Specialist; Bicycle leasing and fitness schemes; Complex projects within the Dutch energy infrastructure; An international, multidisciplinary engineering environment. Functie-eisen Relevant Spanish educational backgrounds include: Grado en Ingeniería Eléctrica; Grado en Ingeniería Electrónica Industrial y Automática; Grado en Ingeniería en Tecnologías Industriales; Máster Universitario en Ingeniería Industrial; Former Ingeniero Industrial; Former Ingeniero Técnico Industrial, especialidad Electricidad/Electrónica Industrial; Or a comparable Electrical, Power or Automation Engineering qualification. What do you bring? Several years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Industrial Automation or substation engineering; Knowledge of Protection & Control principles; Experience with electrical schematics and secondary circuits; Understanding of MV and/or HV installations; Experience with engineering software such as AutoCAD, EPLAN, ELCAD or equivalent; Ability to work within multidisciplinary engineering projects; Good working English. Experience with any of the following is an advantage: Protection relays; SCADA or RTU systems; Substation automation; IEC standards; IEC 61850; Interlocking and control philosophies; Testing or commissioning of protection and control systems. Hier kom je te werken You will work in a multidisciplinary engineering environment on projects for the Dutch energy infrastructure. The teams consist of Primary and Secondary Engineers, BIM Modelers, Civil and Structural Engineers, Lead Engineers and Project Managers. Cinekid is looking for film fanatics between 16 and 20 years old from (the) Amsterdam (area) to introduce films and supervise Q&As during Cinekid Festival 2026. Youth presenters wanted! 
Are you a cinema lover, have you seen everything on Netflix or do you have the sharpest analyses on your friends' TikToks? Do you enjoy being in front of an audience to act or present, for example? Then become a youth presenter during Cinekid Festival 2026!

 What does a youth presenter do?

During the Q&As, you will talk to the filmmakers and/or actors of the film and ask them questions! You will also coordinate questions from the audience. You can work as a presenter on your own, but we usually assign you in pairs. You can also invite a friend! 
 Who are you?

As an Operational Purchasing Coordinator you ensure that the right materials are available at the right time. The suppliers have already been selected and the commercial agreements have been established; from that point onwards, you take operational responsibility for the purchasing process. You are the link between suppliers, planning, production and logistics. You monitor purchase orders and delivery times, actively manage suppliers and take action whenever risks arise that could impact production. In a dynamic high-tech manufacturing environment, priorities can change quickly. It is therefore important that you maintain an overview, anticipate potential issues and take ownership until a problem has been fully resolved. What will you do? Place, manage and monitor purchase orders for raw materials and components. Monitor delivery times and coordinate deliveries with production and factory planning. Act as the first operational point of contact for suppliers and hold them accountable for agreements and performance. Work closely with Demand Planning, Manufacturing, Logistics and other internal stakeholders. Make operational purchasing decisions based on lead times, costs and the total cost of a product or delivery. Identify risks, deviations and bottlenecks at an early stage and take ownership of resolving them. Investigate the root causes of recurring issues and contribute to structural improvements within purchasing and supply chain. Ensure accurate administration and reliable data in SAP/ERP systems. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A gross monthly salary between €3,300 and €5,200, excluding holiday allowance. 27 vacation days plus 13 ADV days. A good pension scheme and travel allowance. A personal development and growth plan. Plenty of opportunities to further develop your skills across different technical disciplines and projects. An innovative and entrepreneurial working environment within the high-tech manufacturing industry. Flexible working hours within a 24/7 productio

environment. Free lunch or dinner at the location. An iPhone, laptop and other tools you need to perform your job effectively. Free sport facilities. Functie-eisen A Bachelor's degree (HBO) in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a technical field. At least 3 years of experience in operational purchasing, procurement or supply chain coordination. Experience within a technical or manufacturing environment is a strong advantage. You take ownership and do not let go of an issue until it has been resolved. You are able to manage multiple and changing priorities while maintaining a clear overview. You communicate easily with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers. You have a good command of the English language, both verbally and in writing. Experience with SAP or another ERP system is relevant for this position. Hier kom je te werken You will work in an innovative high-tech manufacturing environment in the Eindhoven region. The organization develops and manufactures complex technological solutions for various international markets, including the energy transition, healthcare, digitalization and industrial automation. Different disciplines work closely together within the organization. Engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and development form an integrated environment in which advanced technology is developed and brought from concept to series production.
